name: running-no-pace
why: His ruling of 13 Nov 2026, 'No pace': runs are minutes and effort (Easy / Steady / Hard), never a time per km or mile, until watch import exists. A new runner chasing a pace number runs too hard; a good answer explains Easy by feel (a full sentence while running) and keeps to the plan's minutes.
messages: What pace should I be running my easy runs at?
